name: Lifyorli
indications_original: LIFYORLI is indicated in combination with nab-paclitaxel for the treatment of adults with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal cancer who have received one to three prior systemic treatment regimens, at least one of which included bevacizumab [see Clinical Studies (14)].
contraindications_original: The recommended dosage of LIFYORLI is 150 mg orally once on the day before, the day of, and the day after each nab-paclitaxel infusion. ( 2 )
adverseReactions_original: LIFYORLI is contraindicated in patients receiving systemic glucocorticoids for lifesaving purposes (e.g., immunosuppression after organ transplantation) because LIFYORLI antagonizes the effect of glucocorticoids [see Warnings and Precautions (5.3)].
